primer: Billionbrains Garage Ventures Limited (NSE: GROWW) is India's largest retail investment platform with 1.35 crore active NSE clients . It holds a 29.16% market share and captured over 60% of net industry client additions in Q2 FY27 . The company stewards ₹3.87 lakh crore in customer assets across mutual funds, equities, derivatives, and margin lending . Its organic funnel delivers a 62.17% TTM operating margin and 28.8% ROE .
